🎥🎬: I Love LA (2026)

A group of ambitious young Angelenos navigate friendships, romance, parties, and career dreams while trying to make it in Los Angeles. As their personal and professional lives collide, the glamorous image of LA begins to give way to the messy reality of chasing success in the city.

With relationships changing and big opportunities creating new pressures, the group must figure out what they actually want—and how much they’re willing to sacrifice to get it. What starts as a carefree LA lifestyle quickly becomes a story about ambition, identity, and growing up.
